breakdown.description: Shallow-water wave speed c = sqrt(g h) applies only when h ≪ λ (e.g., h < λ/20). For deep water, wave speed depends on wavelength, not depth.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the user's incorrect formula. The user provided the shallow-water wave speed formula (c = sqrt(g h)) for a deep-water scenario. The ground truth corrects this to the appropriate deep-water formula (c = sqrt(g λ / (2π))). The agent's generated specification repeated the user's incorrect formula, 'Calculate wave speed using the formula c = sqrt(g * h)'.
